title: Unbounded read_line: MAX_LINE_BYTES checked after allocation
description: Trigger: attacker sends a command line of >>4 KiB with no \n terminator. read_line() buffers the entire stream into line_buf before session.rs:84 checks len. No backpressure or per-read limit exists. Behavior: server allocates arbitrarily large buffer, exhausting heap and/or triggering OOM. The MAX_LINE_BYTES guard is post-read, not pre-read. Fix: wrap reader with AsyncReadExt::take() capped at MAX_LINE_BYTES+2 before calling read_line, or switch to a byte-by-byte loop with an inline counter.
